subject: Meteorology
title: Novaya Zemlya Effect
description: A short lesson to help you apply Novaya Zemlya Effect.

hook.text: The Novaya Zemlya effect makes the Sun visible weeks before it should rise—light bends around the curve of the Earth.

buildup.text: Named after the Arctic island where it was first documented in 1597—Dutch explorers saw the Sun two weeks early.

discovery.text: Strong temperature inversions over ice create a duct—a channel where light curves to follow Earth's surface.

twist.text: The Sun appears as a distorted rectangle or line on the horizon—not a normal disk, because the duct stretches the image.

climax.text: No one believed the Dutch explorers until the phenomenon was scientifically confirmed centuries later.

punchline.text: Seeing the Sun around the curve of the Earth—nature's ultimate trick.

quiz.question: What makes the Novaya Zemlya effect possible?
options: Strong inversions create a light duct curving around the Earth
